name: game-dev-combat-skill-polish
description: Score a game's combat skills and spells out of 10 with blind judges, then raise the weakest to a bar, for timing and readability (does a skill read as itself, does the blow land when it lands) and for art (detail, light, trails, impact, art direction, judged against a reference such as Diablo IV).
